messages:
Luca Marino: Hey folks — noticed my 12/15 paycheck had both CA and CO state tax withheld. I moved to Denver on 2025-08-01 and updated my home address in the profile, but the paystub still shows CA state withholding + CO withholding (double withholding). Net was down ~$420.
Emma Blake: @Luca Marino thanks for flagging, ugh. Can you paste the paystub screenshot or the payrun id? we'll escalate to payroll ops.
Luca Marino: payrun id is PR-20251215-07, employee RID-4589. Stub shows CA withheld $210.45 and CO withheld $210.12. I only expect CO withholding after 2025-08-01.
Payroll Bot: Auto-ticket created: PR-4829. Vendor: ADP. Priority: high. Assigned: Jon Peters.
Jon Peters: got it, looking now. Two quick Qs: did you have any CA-sourced income (onsite client work) after the move? and did you ever submit a CA nonresident form to ADP? If not, that explains CA withholding.
Luca Marino: No CA work after 8/1, all remote. Didn’t submit a nonresident form — I thought the address change would be enough.
Emma Blake: For midyear moves we usually need two things: profile address change + state residency form (CA nonresident/CO resident). Payroll vendor requires the form to stop continuing CA withholding. We'll get retro adjustments processed.
Jon Peters: I'm going to request a retro refund for the CA taxes withheld since 8/1 for the pay periods flagged and reallocate state wages for W-2 purposes. ADP needs a signed CA Form DE-4 & CO D-4 (or equivalent). @Payroll Bot please attach forms to ticket.
Payroll Bot: Attached: CA nonresident form template (DE-4-like), CO state withholding form link. Ticket PR-4829 updated with attachments.
Luca Marino: Thanks — I'll fill and sign now. Quick Q: does this mean my 2025 W-2 will show CA wages? will we issue corrections?
Jon Peters: Short answer: yes, initial W-2 will reflect what was processed. After we finish the retro reallocation we will request amended state filings and issue W-2 adjustments if needed (W-2c or state equivalents). This can take 4-8 weeks depending on vendor processing + state response. We'll keep you posted.
Emma Blake: Also note: if the CA refund is processed to payroll, the net will show as an off-cycle correction or on next payroll depending on cutoff. We'll prioritize to avoid further withholding.
Luca Marino: Appreciate it. One more — how will this affect my estimated tax payments? I do quarterly payments.
Jon Peters: We'll include a summary of corrected state wages and withheld amounts in the ticket. You can use that to adjust Q4 estimated payments; feel free to ping me and I'll provide exact numbers once ADP completes the recalcs.
Maya Chen: tagging tax team FYI — @Jon Peters please loop in our external tax counsel if ADP flags any multi-state residency issues.
Jon Peters: Will do. Luca — please drop the signed forms in the ticket by EOD and I'll confirm receipt.
Luca Marino: Done, uploaded the signed CO D-4 and CA nonresident form to the ticket. :thumbsup:
Payroll Bot: Ticket PR-4829 status: waiting on payroll ops review. ETA first update: 3 business days.
Emma Blake: Thanks everyone. Luca, we'll update here as we get vendor confirmation. :wave:
